summary: Narrow sloping residential kerb; homes 11-13 m behind it.
reasons: Cars park at the south end

best_section.where: West kerb of Central Avenue, where cars already park below the bend

drivers.seclusion: Large homes 9-15 m behind the kerb; homes across the road 30 m or more away.
drivers.access_and_room: Narrow street, but cars already park at the south end; room to pull in.
drivers.convention: Cars park along the kerb, though signed 2P with resident permits.

flags: Steep: about 6.8% grade, up to 9.4% locally
Dwelling 9 m from the kerb at about 8 m
sun_shade: Dense trees shade the section from the west and south.
